# HookForge

> Free, no-signup generator for TikTok hooks, YouTube Shorts intros, Instagram Reels captions, CapCut on-screen text, and Facebook Reels openers. Built for US creators. English (US).

HookForge is a client-side tool. It does not give medical, legal, or financial advice. It does not scrape platforms.
